title: Back to the Future
description: A teenager is sent thirty years into the past in a scientist's time machine and must make sure his parents meet, or he will never be born.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Two people who keep running into each other over twelve years argue about whether men and women can ever just be friends.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A grumpy weatherman wakes up to the same February morning again and again until he learns to change.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: A famous detective and his companion investigate the legend of a ghostly hound on the moors.

title: Battle of Britain
description: Fighter squadrons defend the country's skies during the war: dogfights, losses and short breaks between sorties.

title: The Snowman
description: On a winter night a boy's snowman comes to life and takes him flying over the snowy countryside.

title: Miracle
description: A coach builds a team of college players who take on the Soviet national team on the ice at the 1980 Winter Olympics, chasing every puck.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Actors from an old space show are mistaken for real heroes by aliens and dragged into a conflict between planets.

title: The Apartment
description: A shy insurance clerk lends his apartment to his bosses and falls in love with the elevator operator in his office.

title: WALL-E
description: A small cleaning robot left alone on an abandoned Earth follows a visiting robot into space.
